chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Bakkar from Sulayman ibn Khalid from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who died and left behind a son who was a slave, and he left no other heir, and he left wealth, he said: 'The son is purchased and freed, and what remains of the wealth is inherited.'

key_terms.مَمْلُوك: slave (specifically a slave owned by the father)

ai.seo_question: What happens to the inheritance of a man who leaves only a slave son?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'itq bi'l-mal' (manumission through estate funds), ensuring the slave son's transition from servitude to free status before inheritance distribution. It highlights the Shia juristic view that the son's emancipation is a prerequisite for his eligibility as the sole heir, resolving the legal ambiguity of a slave's capacity to inherit. This mechanism protects the lineage and property rights of the deceased's offspring within the broader framework of Islamic inheritance law.
